concepts_actual_uses_and_mixup: Iteration spawn projects a selected weapon/shield and authored armor placement into transient Bevy items. Owner Entity, TacticalInventoryItemId and catalog ID name different identities; same numeric synthetic item slots are scoped to each owner. Native skill-weight/body-part arrays are indexed framework/geometry projections, not enums of arbitrary numbers.

Actual armor projection selects a catalog placement by repeated item occurrence but reads broad build.combatant.equipment.armor[body_part_index(part)] for fit/resistance/coverage/padding. This supports existing own11 ALIAS003 selected equipment-view obligation; do not introduce another broad-loadout proxy or claim current selected owner migration is unnecessary.

Grip/head/dimensions/anchor displacement carry distinct geometric meanings at native collider/projection boundaries. ArmorSlot intentionally combines broad armor region and side, while BodyPart identifies anatomy; preserve explicit mapping and authored covered-parts/coverage geometry rather than merging their roles.
receipts.disposition: Retain meaningful participant/attack/selected equipment, timing, geometry, action/status/outcome, armor and condition-unit distinctions. Support existing own11 aliases001/003/004 and F001 where traced, without new unique issue count. Native DTO/Bevy adapters are not whole input/graph/state clearance.

Whole decision/event payload combinations remain existing own11ALIAS004 obligation, not cleared by the mere presence of enums.

IterationClock.tick is a tick ordinal; simulated_ticks is an execution count; TacticalElapsed is a seconds projection. Existing source406 timeout count defect remains CAMERA-INITIAL07-F034; no new chrono-owner implementation coverage from imports/calls here. Event sequence and attack key are distinct ordinal versus attack association.

Participant names are presentation labels and lose framework Entity association in retained diagnostic records; preserve existing full combatant/attack identity obligation (own11ALIAS001), not assume uniqueness from the fixture roster. Numeric incapacitation/fraction/energy/flow/distance columns retain distinct semantics at serialized report boundary.

Current record_attack_start derives actual centre-to-centre XZ distance, not surface gap. record_condition_changes retains per-cause previous/current/delta, log_new_wounds retains blood-fraction flow and body region; source values are real condition projections, not extra hidden combat impairment. Existing broad scalar/prose cause and cross-stage payload obligations remain separate.

Optional ArmorImpact supplies correlated armor identity/material/outcome/energy. No new strictly-positive energy bound justified for legitimate zero damage or absent armor.

Resolved log projection currently samples defender inventory slots for implement/catalog/inventory identity and armor layer chain while contact event owns resolved contact/geometry. Preserve selected immutable receipt versus live inventory distinction for connected admission/identity reconciliation; no actual concurrent mutation or wrong emitted item is proved here.

Scheduled/ideal/actual contact measure, contact lever arm, energy fraction and accuracy multiplier are different meanings despite compatible underlying scalar representations. Current logged center separation is actual XZ distance; do not replace it with signed surface gap during physical owner migration.

Defensive implement None means no slot; Other means a present slot not classified as current shield/weapon, and BodySide::Both cannot project one hand slot. Native enum-to-serialized text is an explicit diagnostic boundary, not proof of public typed admission.
